email_draft.subject: Robert, Larkspur's 2,600 IEPs, half the time | Journify
email_draft.body:
Robert, Dr. Tan followed up after ASU+GSV Summit 2026 and specifically asked us to connect with you as Larkspur moves into SPED platform selection for 2026-27.

With roughly 2,600 IEPs under California's documentation requirements, your case managers and related-service providers are likely spending more time on paperwork than with students. Journify works on top of SEIS, no migration, no disruption, and teachers report saving more than four hours per day on IEP drafting, progress notes, and instructional materials, so your team's afternoons go to students, not screens.

Open to a 30-minute working session this week or next so we can scope this to your 2026-27 timeline?
